name: Professional Agile Leadership
name_ja: プロフェッショナル・アジャイル・リーダーシップ

logistics.format: Online open-book multiple-choice / multiple-answer / true-false assessment on agile leadership; passing score 85%

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 2, introductory: 1. The ordered median is foundational. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded agile-leadership framework offers entry management knowledge, but open entry and a short multiple-choice assessment do not substantiate executive responsibility despite the recognition factor.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The accessible agile-leadership assessment provides foundational management vocabulary. Zero experience and a one-hour open-book objective exam do not demonstrate executive leadership or technical security capability.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded leadership assessment requires no experience and is entirely objective, with explicitly limited depth. Its nontechnical scope supplies introductory delivery-method literacy rather than security leadership evidence.
